CloudDraft.title: CloudDraft
CloudDraft.description: AI-generated or edited educational draft synchronized to Firestore per authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

workspaceId.description: Workspace identifier associated with the draft.

provider.description: AI provider label or manual editor.

model.description: Model name used to produce the draft.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

templateId.description: Prompt template identifier used for this generation; optional for legacy drafts.

templateVersion.description: Prompt template version captured when the draft was generated.

responseSchemaHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the response schema, or empty when no schema was used.

requestFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the generation request and selected provider/model.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the persisted draft content.

sourcePdfHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source PDF, or empty when no PDF was attached.

LessonProgress.title: LessonProgress
LessonProgress.description: Synchronized lesson completion, quiz score, and XP record per authenticated user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

completed.description: Whether the lesson has been completed.

xpEarned.description: Experience points earned for this lesson.

notes.description: Optional teacher or learner notes for the lesson.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated user role and optional class enrollment record used during post-sign-in routing.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

role.description: Application access role determining Admin Dashboard or Student View redirect.

enrolledGradeKey.description: Optional classroom grade key assigned to a student (e.g. G04).

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AiModelDefinition.title: AiModelDefinition
AiModelDefinition.description: System-wide AI model entry managed only by a pre-provisioned system administrator.

modelId.description: Provider-facing model identifier and version; also used as the Firestore document ID.

displayName.description: Human-readable model name shown in model selection.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default model for its provider.

isEnabled.description: Whether users may select this model.

SystemAdminAccess.title: SystemAdminAccess
SystemAdminAccess.description: Out-of-band allowlist grant for privileged system-wide management actions.

permissions.description: Explicit system-level capabilities granted to the UID.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user role document queried after sign-in to route to Admin Dashboard or Student View.

/users/{userId}/drafts/{draftId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced educational drafts created or edited in the Studio.

/users/{userId}/progress/{progressId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced lesson completion and quiz mastery progress.

/ai_model_catalog/{modelId}.description: Global model catalogue. Authenticated users can read; only users whose pre-provisioned users/{uid}.role is admin can create, update, or delete.

/system_admins/{userId}.description: Out-of-band system administrator allowlist. A user can read only their own grant; client writes are denied. Model catalogue writes require role=admin and manage_ai_models grant.
